nuggets.text: The Seawolves trailed Lindenwood 22-7 at halftime, then outscored them 29-10 in the second half to win 36-32.
Seth Sweitzer became the 21st Seawolf ever to reach 150 receiving yards, catching 12 passes for 157 against Lindenwood.
CJ Hester has opened the season with two straight games of at least 90 rushing yards and a touchdown.
The Seawolves have won six straight home games dating back to last season.
Seawolves QB Aidan Leffler transferred in from Ball State, the very team Stony Brook visits on Saturday.
Billy Cosh was 31 when Stony Brook hired him in December 2023, the second-youngest active Division I head football coach.
Seawolves coach Billy Cosh was a quarterback at four schools: Kansas State, James Madison, Butler CC and Houston.
The Seawolves' first win over an FBS opponent came in 2012, a 23-3 victory over Army.
LaValle Stadium, home of the Seawolves, is the largest outdoor facility in Suffolk County.
Saturday is the first-ever meeting between the Seawolves and Ball State, their lone FBS opponent this season.
